correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the universal r,s≥3 blow-up intersection calculation with A·B=1, E²=−1, disjoint strict transforms V_i²=−s and H_j²=−r. The grid ideal (F,G) gives basepoint-free L=rA+sB−ΣE; L·(−K)=2r+2s−rs=δ. If δ<0 this nef intersection prohibits pseudo-effectivity. If δ>0, slope (s−2)/s<λ<2/r gives an effective sum of grid fibers plus a positive-bidegree ample pullback, hence −K big. At δ=0 vertical/horizontal negative intersections and total bidegrees each 2m force unique V/H multiplicities a=m(s−2)/s, b=m(r−2)/r; only three wall pairs, ring k[z] with generator degree 3 or 2. Pairwise disjoint support with coefficient <m means no effective representative can vanish to multiplicity m at any further blown-up point. Independent rational sweep r,s=3..30 confirmed phase boundary and positive witness. Symbolic geometric argument, not finite sweep, proves all r,s.
